name: watch-deck
body: Watch deck: watch deck files (slides/, assets/, kalide.yaml) and the RESOLVED library's structure (the configured `templates:` path when set, else the local `templates/` — its library.yaml and its slides/, sections/, themes/, media/ subtrees only; any other top-level entry in the library root is ignored), debounce, publish deck-changed; on change reload templates→validate→render and publish deck-rebuilt. A change to the configured `templates:` value is not a live retarget: the session's library root is pinned at startup, so the change publishes the full-page restart-required error instead of reloading a different library (see template-retarget-requires-restart).
